hypothesis: A dangling INSERT at the 256-token limit can disable all deterministic source records, even though valid model writes were applied. Correct this execution confound before using cross-dialogue span advantages. A missing source annotation at the chosen span never suffices to create new selection credit.
repair: Activate only when a selected INSERT has a dated single/adjacent-turn source rule, an actual completion used its entire output cap, ended on a standalone ACTION: INSERT, had at least one earlier successful INSERT and exactly one failure which was the final empty INSERT. Discard only that failed placeholder; run the original deduplicated source rule. Keep all other parsed content, the prompt, original response and cap. Leave API failures, uncapped incomplete actions and other parse failures untouched. This is a separate counterfactual writer. Verify factual trace, ordered bank, retrieval, reader answer, tokens, F1 and stable references. If the first write changes, use the original ordered suffix skills on the recomputed retrieval; if that physical prompt changes, request a fresh deterministic answer. Preserve per-stage raw response and whether it was reused. Recoveries by same-skill repair withhold extra selection credit.
cohort: Training includes the original 12 early factorial windows (91 questions, 48 paths) and 12 randomized donor windows (88 questions, 24 paths). Census every actual path; untriggered paths are identity controls. Measure all questions of all triggered paths. Start with the unlinked exact-recovery question 112 in conv-43_s11/01, then complete every registered question. Only aggregate a window once denominators match. Report retrospective and prospective scores separately; keep the 40 later randomized windows (378 questions), independent development and full tests outside training.
learning: Compare the same cross-history kernel on the actor state and the same equal-history donor weights as late_credit_kernel. All use identical terminal returns from healthy training paths. Baseline adds verified original signed skill credit; provisional mask sets the target on a contrast containing a triggering path to zero, preserving its weight. Repaired variant replaces its raw training gap with the measured gap under the same-skill writer repair, keeping original extra selection credit only when both the direction and strict reference recovery persist, capped by the smaller absolute effect. Compare paired and masked versions, each with/without extra credit, the unadjusted credit and return kernels, native, terminal and matched-rate policies on factual later paths. No new positive label comes from an execution repair. Freeze donor receipts and the fitted mapping before scoring later outcomes. Require full eligible coverage, at least +0.02 vs native and terminal, improvement over matched rate, raw and unadjusted control, at least four positive histories relative to rate and a positive strict prospective effect before independent validation.
